scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix sharedFiles && npm ci --prefix Backend && npm ci --prefix Frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix Backend run build && npm --prefix Frontend run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,backend,frontend "npm --prefix sharedFiles run watch" "npm --prefix Backend run dev" "npm --prefix Frontend run dev"
